text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the central plaza, I 
spotted Sounds of Earth.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Let's see... Is this... like this, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, haha! I see... so that's how it made 
you feel!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Grazie! I felt it, your commozione!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, Sounds of Earth started 
playing the violin after reading the 
letter. What on earth could this mean...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oho, my inquisitive tambourine. Curious, 
are you?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... To tell the truth, I received this 
fan letter from an amore who adores me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth showed me a fan letter she 
received. On it, handwritten musical notes 
were penned across a musical staff.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"This amore seemed to have felt a melody 
in my running—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
They wrote this musical score completely 
guided by commozione, they say!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While nodding in understanding, there was 
one thing I could say.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thanks to my amore, a brand-new 
melodia has awakened inside me...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Led by our passione— Come, suoniamo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth finds music in racing, and 
her fans find music in her running— It may 
be unique, but it might just be a 
wonderful relationship.
